Arbitration outcome & strategic shift: ICSID dismissed the company's USMCA/NAFTA claim; management is assessing an annulment and refocusing efforts on resolving the blockade and pursuing alternative projects.

Operations pause at Sierra Mojada: A blockade has halted on-site work; the company's primary 2026 focus is resolving the blockade and maintaining Mexican concessions before any resumption of exploration activity.
Funding and litigation impact: Termination of Bench Walk funding after an adverse award ended litigation-funded exploration and corporate expense support, reducing on‑ground activity.
Exploration outlook: If the blockade is lifted, management plans to update the exploration program and seek partners or financing to restart Sierra Mojada work and advance project milestones.
